name: Huntboard (démonstration)
postCreateCommand: pip install -r app/backend/requirements.txt pytest && HUNTBOARD_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/huntboard-demo python scripts/demo_data.py
postStartCommand: bash -c 'cd app/backend && HUNTBOARD_DATA_DIR=/workspaces/huntboard-demo nohup python -m uvicorn huntboard.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/huntboard.log 2>&1 &'
